## src/planet/extract/contract.ts

[Source](contract.ts)

One downloaded district, before it becomes a scene.

`MapFeature` is an OSM way or relation already closed into rings.
`WorldExtract` is the origin, the heightfield and those features.
`IRUN_VENTAS` is the example district and the default origin for tests.

## Module dependencies

- `../../math/geo/sphere.js`
- `../land/terrain.js`

This module contains declarations, data or re-exports; it defines no executable functions.

## src/planet/extract/multipolygon.ts

[Source](multipolygon.ts)

OSM multipolygon relations.

Member ways are tagged outer or inner and often arrive split. They are joined at shared
endpoints into closed rings. A missing member does not drop the rings that did close.

## Module dependencies

- `../../math/planar/polygon.js`

## src/planet/extract/source.ts

Elevation is an Esri Terrain3D grid. Features are already closed OSM rings.

## src/planet/extract/tags.ts

[Source](tags.ts)

OpenStreetMap rules used when a district becomes a scene.

Colours turn `building:colour` and `roof:colour` into #RRGGBB.
Tags lists which OSM keys are kept on an entity; addresses stay in the extract.
